summary: Iteration 109 — tested FOODbakēd Pickup/Dine-in hero toggle (backend + frontend). 9/9 backend pytest cases pass and 9/9 frontend scenarios green. All review-spec acceptance criteria verified: dine_in alias accepted (no 422), canonical to reservation, same IDs as mode=reservation; pickup/dine_in restaurant counts match seed data (2/3); FR default toggle labels; EN toggle labels; instant carousel refetch without reload on mode switch; Commander à emporter + Réserver une table CTAs; dine_in card routes to /reservations; localStorage baked_food_mode persists on reload AND cross-page nav; Top Brands carousel refetches on mode change (6→2→3 brands).
critical_code_review_comments: discovery.py _serialize elegantly maps the UI alias dine_in → reservation at the top of the function so every downstream filter (home/discovery/brands/top/check) inherits the behaviour from one place — clean single-source-of-truth.

FoodHome.jsx RestaurantCard CTA label is derived from (mode === 'dine_in' && r.reservations_enabled) rather than reservation_eligible — safe because backend already filters at only_eligible layer, but switching to r.reservation_eligible would make the component self-contained and defensive against caller mistakes.

FoodHome lat/lng are passed into useEffect as deps but 'mode' and 'activeAddress' can both change between renders; current implementation correctly refetches /food/home AND propagates mode to TopBrandsCarousel so it re-fetches /food/brands/top — verified working.
Minor: RestaurantCard renders CTA badge styled as a span inside the parent <Link>; semantically the entire card is already a link to /reservations, so no double-nav risk.
seed_data_creation: None — relied on existing CI seed (delivery=5, pickup=2 [Burger Hub+Pizza Palace], dine_in=3 [Burger Hub+Sushi Central+Le Gourmet])
context_for_next_testing_agent: FOODbakēd service mode toggle fully covered. Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_food_mode_toggle.py (9 cases). Dine_in dine_in is a canonical alias for reservation at discovery.py:96. Mode is persisted in localStorage key 'baked_food_mode' via BakedContexts.AppProvider and threaded to RestaurantCard + TopBrandsCarousel. Dine_in cards route to /foodbaked/restaurants/<slug>/reservations.

frontend: FR default labels: Livraison / À emporter / Sur place

Top Brands count changes: delivery=6, pickup=2, dine_in=3 (confirms carousel refetches on mode change)
